facts.claim: zenodo.org and mdpi.com blocked by proxy (403 CONNECT); GitHub HTML page 403 for this session
Mirror readable via git; HEAD 0356bb5b37ef0992ec0df3a4f09be35e3147b094, same commit as AST-A06
stop_times.txt (167675554 B) and segment_level_data.csv (49841502 B) are Git LFS pointers only
55 consecutive service days 2024-07-29..2024-09-21, no gaps; 15 weekend days
AST-A06 R1/R1b/R2 reproduced: JSON outputs byte-identical, CSV identical except line endings; 19769 trips, 201 stops, 3 routes
License CC BY 4.0 stated only in mirror READ-ME.txt; mirror has no LICENSE; not verified on Zenodo

0 of 16909 consecutive same-vehicle trip pairs overlap; no vehicle switches route within a day
Within-day headway CV median 0.675 vs pooled 0.82 (weekday, cleaned); excess wait H/2*CV^2 becomes 1.4-7.8 min (median 3.75), >2 min in 16 of 18 (formula = assumption)
76.7% of consecutive same-vehicle trips start <=60 s after previous end (median 13 s): trip duration includes terminal layover, not a congestion measure
